# Xala Digilist Monorepo - Comprehensive Project Analysis

## Project Introduction

Xala Digilist is a sophisticated **SaaS platform** designed for rental property management and booking systems. This enterprise-grade monorepo serves as a unified solution for managing rental objects, bookings, tenant relationships, and multi-tenant SaaS operations across multiple application interfaces.

### Purpose Statement
The platform provides a complete digital infrastructure for rental property operators, enabling them to manage listings, handle bookings, coordinate with stakeholders, and operate as a hosted SaaS service across multiple tenant environments.

### Core Goals and Objectives
- **Multi-Tenant Architecture**: Support for multiple independent organizations within a single platform
- **Unified API**: Enterprise-grade GraphQL and REST endpoints for consistent data access
- **Real-Time Capabilities**: WebSocket-based real-time communication for live updates
- **Comprehensive RBAC**: Fine-grained role-based access control across all application layers
- **Enterprise Security**: JWT-based authentication with comprehensive audit logging

### Target Audience
- **Property Managers**: Frontline operators managing rental properties
- **Organizational Administrators**: Back-office staff handling tenant operations
- **SaaS Platform Operators**: Multi-tenant service providers managing multiple organizations
- **End Customers**: Individual users searching for and booking rental properties

## Technical Architecture

The project follows a **modular monorepo architecture** with clear separation of concerns across backend APIs, frontend applications, and shared packages.

```mermaid
graph TD
    subgraph "Monorepo Structure"
        A[apps/api] --> B[apps/web]
        A --> C[apps/backoffice]
        A --> D[apps/minside]
        A --> E[apps/saas-admin]
        A --> F[apps/tenant-admin]
        
        G[packages/auth] --> A
        G --> B
        G --> C
        G --> D
        G --> E
        G --> F
        
        H[packages/client-sdk] --> B
        H --> C
        H --> D
        H --> E
        H --> F
        
        I[packages/ds] --> B
        I --> C
        I --> D
        I --> E
        I --> F
        
        J[packages/database-schema] --> A
    end
    
    subgraph "Infrastructure"
        K[PostgreSQL Database]
        L[Nginx Reverse Proxy]
        M[Docker Containers]
    end
    
    A --> K
    L --> A
    L --> B
    L --> C
    L --> D
    L --> E
    L --> F
    M --> L
```

### Component Breakdown

The architecture consists of several key layers:

**1. API Layer (apps/api)**
- Fastify-based REST API with GraphQL support
- Modular controller architecture with dependency injection
- PostgreSQL database with Drizzle ORM
- WebSocket real-time communication

**2. Application Layer**
- **Web Portal**: Customer-facing property browsing and booking
- **Backoffice**: Property manager dashboard and operations
- **Min Side**: Personal tenant portal
- **SaaS Admin**: Platform-wide administration
- **Tenant Admin**: Organization-level management

**3. Shared Packages Layer**
- **Authentication**: Centralized auth system with multiple providers
- **Client SDK**: Type-safe API client for all applications
- **Design System**: Component library and theming
- **Database Schema**: Single source of truth for database definitions

### Design Patterns

The project implements several enterprise design patterns:

- **Repository Pattern**: Data access abstraction layer
- **Dependency Injection**: Container-based service resolution
- **Module System**: NestJS-inspired module orchestration
- **Adapter Pattern**: Pluggable service adapters
- **Command Query Responsibility Segregation (CQRS)**: Separation of read and write operations

## Key Implementation

### Main Entry Points

**API Server** (`apps/api/src/main.ts`)
The central API server orchestrates the entire platform, implementing a comprehensive dependency injection container and modular architecture.

**Frontend Applications** (`apps/*/src/App.tsx`)
Each application implements a similar structure with routing, authentication, and theme management.

**Client SDK** (`packages/client-sdk/src/index.ts`)
Provides type-safe access to all API endpoints with React Query integration.

### Core Modules

**Container System** (`apps/api/src/core/container.ts`)
Lightweight dependency injection container supporting singleton and factory patterns.

**Module Loader** (`apps/api/src/core/module.ts`)
NestJS-inspired module orchestration with import/export semantics.

**Database Schema** (`packages/database-schema/src/index.ts`)
Single source of truth for all database definitions organized by domain modules.

### Configuration Approach

**Package Management** (`package.json`, `pnpm-workspace.yaml`)
- PNPM workspace configuration for monorepo management
- Turbo pipeline for build optimization
- Shared development dependencies

**Environment Configuration**
- `.env.example` files for each application
- Docker-based environment setup
- Nginx reverse proxy configuration

### External Dependencies

**Core Runtime Dependencies**:
- Fastify (HTTP server framework)
- Drizzle ORM (PostgreSQL database toolkit)
- Mercurius (GraphQL integration)
- React (Frontend framework)
- TanStack Query (React Query)

**Development Dependencies**:
- TypeScript (Type safety)
- Vitest (Testing framework)
- Playwright (E2E testing)
- ESLint (Code quality)

### Integration Points

**Authentication Integration** (`packages/auth/src/config/index.ts`)
- ID-porten (Norwegian official identity provider)
- Vipps (Norwegian payment provider)
- Microsoft (Azure AD)
- OAuth 2.0 standard compliance

**Real-Time Communication** (`apps/api/src/modules/websocket/websocket.controller.ts`)
- WebSocket connections for live updates
- Event broadcasting across tenants
- Connection lifecycle management

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Client
    participant API
    participant WebSocket
    participant Database
    
    Client->>+API: GraphQL Request
    API->>+Database: Query Data
    Database-->>-API: Return Results
    API-->>-Client: GraphQL Response
    
    Client->>+WebSocket: Subscribe to Events
    WebSocket->>+Database: Listen for Changes
    Database-->>-WebSocket: Notify Updates
    WebSocket-->>-Client: Real-time Event
```

## Key Features

### Functionality Overview

**Multi-Tenant SaaS Platform**
- Tenant isolation with shared resources
- Organization hierarchies and membership management
- Role-based access control per tenant
- Subscription and entitlement management

**Property Management System**
- Rental object catalog with rich metadata
- Booking management with availability checking
- Pricing engine with dynamic rates
- Image and media management

**Communication Hub**
- Real-time messaging between parties
- Notification system with preferences
- Audit logging for compliance
- Activity feeds and timelines

### Implementation Highlights

**GraphQL Integration** (`apps/api/src/graphql/schema.ts`)
Enterprise-grade GraphQL schema with code-first approach, supporting complex queries and mutations.

**Real-Time Events** (`apps/api/src/modules/websocket/websocket.controller.ts`)
WebSocket-based real-time communication for live updates across all application layers.

**Authentication System** (`packages/auth/src/providers/AuthProvider.tsx`)
Centralized authentication with multiple providers, cross-tab synchronization, and flow context preservation.

**Design System** (`packages/ds/src/index.ts`)
Comprehensive component library with 500+ components organized into primitives, composed, and blocks layers.

### Feature Architecture

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Unauthenticated
    Unauthenticated --> Authenticating: Login Attempt
    Authenticating --> Authenticated: Success
    Authenticating --> Unauthenticated: Failure
    Authenticated --> TenantSelection: Select Organization
    TenantSelection --> Application: Access Granted
    Application --> BookingFlow: Create Booking
    BookingFlow --> PaymentProcessing: Process Payment
    PaymentProcessing --> Completed: Payment Success
    PaymentProcessing --> Failed: Payment Failure
    Completed --> [*]
    Failed --> [*]
```

**Component Relationship Diagram**

```mermaid
graph LR
    subgraph "Authentication Layer"
        A[AuthProvider] --> B[Auth Hooks]
        B --> C[Protected Routes]
    end
    
    subgraph "Data Layer"
        D[SDK Client] --> E[API Controllers]
        E --> F[Repositories]
        F --> G[Database]
    end
    
    subgraph "UI Layer"
        H[Components] --> I[Pages]
        I --> J[Routers]
    end
    
    A --> D
    C --> H
    E --> H
```

This comprehensive monorepo architecture demonstrates enterprise-level software engineering practices, providing a scalable foundation for rental property management platforms while maintaining clean separation of concerns and robust extensibility for future enhancements.
